findings.finding: Karpinski attributes al-Fakhrī’s reuse of particular Abū Kāmil problems and solutions to al-Karajī, and Tou estimates its composition around 1010; the earlier-use inference and date are proposed separately, with the later al-Qurashī event preserved.

Ibn Khaldūn’s favorable judgment is earlier by his 1406 death but a different recognition category; no specific 1377 appearance was established because the Muqaddimah had later revisions.
